# Instructions for repository agents
- Read SPEC.md before editing.
- Do not use dict, set or built-in hash() under src/. Use the custom hash tables.
- Make tests cover edge cases before changing implementations; do not change tests just to make failing code pass.
- Run `make test` after code changes and show the result.
- Each GitHub issue uses a feature/<issue number>-<short name> branch from develop. Record actual progress on the issue, commit, merge to develop and push only when explicitly authorized.
- Review all changes; summarize changes in 3 lines or fewer for a first-year student.
Do not modify SPEC.md or PLAN.md without explaining the reason for the change.

After running experiments, save the measured results as CSV files and generate SVG graphs.

Do not claim a task is complete unless its implementation and tests have been verified.
ㄴ
